name: relaylab
description: RelayLab: receive, inspect, replay, and debug webhooks

scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && pnpm db:roles && pnpm migrate && pnpm -r --parallel run "/^dev(:api|:worker)?$/"
scripts.dev:backend: pnpm db:up && pnpm db:roles && pnpm migrate && pnpm --filter @relaylab/backend --parallel run "/^dev:(api|worker)$/"
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.docs:generate: ./backend/scripts/with-env.sh sh -c 'cd backend && RELAYLAB_UPDATE_DOCS=1 RELAYLAB_REQUIRE_DB=1 RELAYLAB_TEST_DATABASE_URL=${RELAYLAB_TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgres://postgres:test-only-postgres@localhost:${POSTGRES_TEST_HOST_PORT:-54321}/postgres?sslmode=disable} go test -count=1 -run "ERDMatchesSchema|LimitsMatchConfig" ./internal/doccheck/'
